\textit{Population:} BASE (iteration-0 artifacts of the base cells). \textit{Unit:} artifact (base cell).
\textit{CI:} 95\% CI: nonparametric cluster bootstrap, percentile intervals, stratified by block (pilot benchmarks resampled among the 12 pilot benchmarks, full\_ext among its 48); seed 20261017; cluster = benchmark; 2,000 replicates (descriptive, unadjusted).
Block: composite.
Cells: percentage (numerator/denominator) of base cells; Q04 over assembled artifacts.
Denominator exclusions (methodology missingness rules; JSON key excluded): no unit is excluded in this table by Q06 (baseline\_incompatible artifact(s)); Q04 (unassembled artifact(s) (Q04 counts over assembled artifacts)).
BL01: Includes dense\_la/00 (BL-01 tolerance convention: possible false FAIL verdicts; disclosure-bearing aggregate); sensitivity SA1 in T10.
REASONING: Reasoning settings differ between models and are not equalised (see the closure disclosure register, item reasoning\_policy\_differences); some providers report no reasoning-token field.
IC1: Q06 is in-sample for test\_feedback and combined\_feedback: their loops see the ParEval test verdict and stop when it passes (every stopped\_tests\_pass trajectory is a Q06 pass), so they optimise the endpoint; for static\_feedback Q06 is out-of-sample (measured once in phase 2, never seen by the loop). The variants therefore differ in trigger and stop rules, not only in feedback content; test\_feedback cannot regress on Q06 by construction.
IC7: The pipeline auto-closes unbalanced braces before measurement; many static\_feedback regressions are base-pass cells whose final repair answer was auto-closed and then failed to build (X01). Q10 (frozen SA2) is unpaired and compares different cohorts.
\textit{Definitions} (methodology; full text in the JSON form of this table): BASE; Q02 assembly\_success; Q05 build\_success; Q06 correctness\_pass; Q04 cleaning\_intervention.\par
